title: Chereze family wins death certificate after legal battle

tellings.quote: After a protracted legal battle, the family finally received the death certificate.

plain: James Fox, who has looked into a series of events said to have happened in 1996 in Varginha, a town in Brazil, tells this on the podcast of host Jesse Michels. He passes on what two people, Roger Leir and a woman named Marta, told him: the family of a man named Marco Chereze spent years in a long legal fight, up to about 2002, and finally got his death certificate, a document linked to a lab called IPD. He tells it because, if true, that document could shed light on how Chereze died during the Varginha events.
